

# whois.exe is all Rust (whois-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/whois-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# whois.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/whois-rust/src/whois/whois.rs)
# The resources are the one thing cmake still compiles, in this OBJECT library
# whose windres command the cargo link replays.
add_library(whois_res OBJECT whois.rc)
target_include_directories(whois_res PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
set(WHOIS_REUSED
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/sdk/lib/crt/CMakeFiles/oldnames.dir/oldnames.a)
add_cargo_module(whois whois-cargo whois.exe
    KIND win32exe
    BODY_CRATE whois-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS whois_res ${WHOIS_REUSED})
